business_summary: Miyakoshi Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development, leasing, and management business in China. The company engages in the promotion of comprehensive urban development of the World Innovation Center in Shenzhen; investment in companies and projects in Japan, China, and other Asian countries; and planning and promotion of comprehensive urban development that addresses environment and energy-saving issues. It is also involved in the import and sale of semiconductors and electronic components. Miyakoshi Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.
